aiService.title: AI Interaction Bridge
aiService.subtitle: Let local AI clients such as Codex safely use serial and configuration capabilities through standard MCP
aiService.usageText: Each software instance only needs to be configured once. Click “Copy MCP configuration” and send the complete content to an AI, which can adapt it to the current MCP Client. The copied content includes a Codex TOML example; other clients may convert the format without changing the connection details. Only Streamable HTTP is supported; STDIO is not. The service listens only on 127.0.0.1.
aiService.stepEnable: Enable the bridge and wait for MCP to be running
aiService.stepCopy: Click “Copy MCP configuration”, then send the complete content to an AI or add it to the current MCP Client yourself
aiService.stepConnect: Ask the AI to connect to this software instance; the AI connection status indicator lights up after a successful connection
aiService.startupPermissionNote: Note: AI permission returns to Read only whenever the application starts. To allow write operations, the user must manually select Full control for the current run.
aiService.bridgeEnabledDesc: Allow local MCP clients to access this instance; effective tools still follow the permission level and capability boundaries.
aiService.aiAccessDesc: The status indicator lights up after Codex or another client completes the MCP handshake and keeps the connection open. Importing the configuration only completes setup; the status changes to connected after a live connection is established.
aiService.permissionDesc: Permission applies only to the current run and is not stored in the local configuration file; every startup begins in Read only. Full control can only be enabled manually from this page, so editing local configuration cannot elevate AI permission.
aiService.instanceSettingsDesc: Configure multi-instance ports and identity. Most users can keep the defaults.
aiService.basePortDesc: Instance ID 1 uses the base port; each subsequent instance increments the port by one.
aiService.basePortConfirm: Changing the base port affects every instance without an override and invalidates old Codex configuration. Continue?
aiService.aliasDesc: Distinguishes multiple concurrently running SuperConnectX instances.
aiService.portOverrideDesc: Overrides only this instance's MCP port; leave blank for automatic assignment.
aiService.portOverrideAuto: Leave blank to assign the port from the instance ID
aiService.feedbackDesc: An overlay reports AI activity immediately; its click behavior, position, opacity and duration are configurable.
aiService.overlayOpacityDesc: Adjust the transparency of AI activity notifications.
aiService.activityLogDesc: Records are written asynchronously to a dedicated ai-activity directory and rotated by size.
aiService.logMaxSizeDesc: The current file is rotated to a timestamped archive when it reaches this limit.
aiService.logMaxFilesDesc: Includes the current file; the oldest archive is removed after the limit is exceeded.
aiService.commandContentModeDesc: Controls how much command text is stored in the local AI activity log. Operation name, result and timestamp remain recorded; suspected passwords, tokens and other secrets are always redacted.
aiService.logDirectoryDesc: Records are stored in an ai-activity child directory; leave blank to use the default application data directory.
aiService.capabilitiesDesc: Only the core capabilities required for serial debugging are exposed: serial connections, terminal I/O, connection profiles, preset commands, business configuration and log queries. Auxiliary features such as themes, virtual serial ports and software updates are outside AI control. Use the switch on the right of each group to enable or disable it; a disabled group remains unavailable even at the Full control permission level.
aiService.capabilityToggleHint: Click to enable or disable this capability group
aiService.activityDesc: Shows AI queries and operations in real time and writes them to a read-only local activity log.
aiService.copied: The MCP configuration and connection instructions have been copied. Send them directly to an AI to connect the current MCP Client.
aiService.copyGuide:
Please connect the current SuperConnectX instance to the MCP Client you are using:

1. The configuration below uses Codex TOML format. If the current client uses another format, convert it without changing the service name, URL, or Authorization value.
2. Keep the URL and Authorization value unchanged, and do not disclose the MCP token.
3. This service uses Streamable HTTP and does not support STDIO.
4. After configuration, connect to {serviceName} and call server_get_info to verify the service.
5. For a continuous connect/send/stop workflow, preserve the writeLeaseId returned by session_start_* or session_acquire_write and include it in later write calls, including after an MCP reconnect.
6. Tell me whether the connection succeeded. If it failed, keep the configuration and report the exact error.

sessionRead.description: Query ports, runtime sessions and connection state, then read or wait for bounded events through cursors.

serialWrite.title: Send terminal commands
serialWrite.description: Acquire the single AI write lease, continue the same workflow across MCP reconnects with writeLeaseId, apply newline, HEX and CRC settings, and optionally wait atomically for a device response.

sessionManage.title: Connect and disconnect sessions
sessionManage.description: Start visible sessions from saved profiles or enumerated ports, and stop sessions when policy allows.

connectionManage.title: Saved connection profiles
connectionManage.description: Read or maintain GUI-exposed profiles; read-only permission permits queries only.

commandManage.title: Preset commands and groups
commandManage.description: Read or maintain command groups and presets without changing the user's current selection.

configManage.title: Business configuration
configManage.description: Read exposed application and COM settings; full control can patch them after revision validation.

auditRead.title: Logs and AI activity
auditRead.description: Read bounded connection logs and AI activity without loading entire files.
